notes.title: End of Demo Service
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289174/fdaf793822c28636a2ae71fffd60b19ffe63df63.png"][/img][/p][p]The current playable demo will no longer be available starting August 25th. [/p][p]After this date, access to the demo will be discontinued and all associated data will be deleted.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Date : August 25th (Mon) 19:00 (PDT)[/p][p][/p][p]An official launch version of the demo is scheduled for release during the upcoming Steam Next Fest this October, so please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate all the users who played the demo and provided valuable feedback. [/p][p]Woof woof! 🐶[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.content:

notes.title: 'My Little Puppy' will support 4 more languages!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289174/1bfa89320227961fda63fbe125e5e036b73fa409.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that [b]4 additional languages[/b] have been added to 'My Little Puppy'!
[list]
[*] Portuguese-Brazil
[*] Polish
[*] Turkish
[*] Thai
[/list]

Additionally, the Steam store page game description are translated, and you can play the official demo with the newly added languages as well!

If you notice any translation errors or have feedback, please feel free to share it with us through the [u]Community Hub[/u].

We sincerely appreciate your continued interest in 'My Little Puppy,' scheduled for release in the second half of 2025. 

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! 🙏

notes.title: Official demo release scheduled for Friday, March 21!

[b]Wishlist & Follow My Little Puppy now to receive the latest updates and be the first to play the demo! 😊[/b]
